_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Copying the site files into a source tree

description: Create the editable source tree of a site that has none by copying the files it serves, so later changes can use write_source_files, apply_edits(target:'source') and build_and_deploy. The served files do not change, and a site that already has source is left as is. Use mode 'force' only after telling the user that build output (minified bundles) is not original source.

mode.description: auto (default): copy plain static files only and refuse build output such as hashed bundles. force: copy build output too.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: promote_dist_to_source

hint.description: Next step when nothing was copied.

noBuild.description: True when no package.json was copied: build_and_deploy then publishes the source as is.

promoted.description: True when this call created the source tree.

reason.description: Why nothing was copied: the site already has a source tree, or auto mode found build output.

title: Copy a site's served files into a new source tree
